{{Quote|Your invasion ends here, Sith. You are severely outnumbered.|Master Rubatin|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Rubatin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==History==
In [[3640 BBY]], Rubatin, fought alongside Masters [[Joce]] and [[Injaye]] during the [[Battle of Corellia|battle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. When they encountered the [[Empire's Wrath|Emperor's Wrath]], Rubatin and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] fought against the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], but were all defeated.

==Behind the scenes==
If the Wrath chooses to expose one of them as a Sith, they could choose to spare Rubatin and Joce for light side points or kill them for dark side points. The option to spare Rubatin and Joce only works if Jaesa Willsaam has been converted to the dark side.
